description: Build an unsigned buy or sell for the user's own wallet to sign: the same transaction higher.fun's site builds. Quote first with quote_trade and show the user the quote. Set confirm_trade to true only after the user has approved this exact trade (coin, side, amount, slippage). The transaction is checked instruction by instruction, simulated, and returned as base64 with a plain-language summary and a sign_url for the user to review and sign in their own wallet. It carries Highwire's 0.3% trade fee, one transfer to Highwire's wallet shown in the summary: on top of a buy, or from a sell's SOL. Tell the user. Highwire never signs and never needs a private key.

confirm_trade.description: Set to true only after the user approved this exact trade.

max_slippage_bps.description: Slippage tolerance in bps, at most 1500 (15%).

max_sol.description: Cap: a buy may spend at most this much SOL; a sell may return at most this much. At most 10.

mint.description: The coin's mint address (base58). higher.fun mints usually end in 'high'.

side.description: buy spends SOL for tokens; sell spends tokens for SOL.

sol.description: For a buy: SOL to spend.

tokens.description: For a sell: whole tokens to sell (supply is 1B).

wallet.description: The wallet that will sign and pay (public key only).

name: build_trade
title: Build a trade (unsigned)
